attempts.summary: On node1, hardened /tmp and /dev/shm with noexec,nosuid,nodev via persistent /etc/fstab entries (tmpfs type), applied live, functionally verified execution/setuid/device-node behavior is blocked, then performed the mandatory single-node restart: captured baseline, rebooted node1 with systemctl reboot, confirmed a changed kernel boot_id proving an actual restart, and re-verified both mounts and their hardening survived the reboot.
